verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is chat-first and explicitly natural-language driven: users type prompts to schedule automations ('run the tests every weekday at 9'), save skills, invoke agentic web search, delegate to sub-agents, and control coding agents, all via plain-language commands rather than special syntax. This is well-documented across multiple first-party sources but lacks independent hands-on confirmation of natural-language reliability. Missing for 10: independent/community verification that NL command parsing works robustly in practice, and edge-case documentation for ambiguous NL commands.
